description: This file is a PHP script that implements the detail view for email templates in SuiteCRM, a customer relationship management platform. It handles rendering the email template details, managing session states, loading associated notes, and generating action buttons.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: A class used to manage the display of detailed views for CRM entities.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: A bean class representing notes attached to CRM records.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes the retrieval of a SugarBean object based on the request parameters.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes associated with the email template.
